# Base capabilities

<!-- Generated by scripts/base-capabilities.py from each module README; do not edit. -->

Before designing a feature, find what Base already does here and build on that module. A Domain or Extension that needs approvals, history, notifications, files, jobs, schedules, settings or time uses the module below, not a table or loop of its own. Small helpers are in [HELPERS.md](HELPERS.md).

To change a row, edit the module README's **Use it for:** or **Not for:** line and run `python3 scripts/base-capabilities.py`.

| Module | Use it for | Not for |
|---|---|---|
| [`base/agent_api`](agent_api/README.md) `bilibi_agent_api`<br>Operation contracts | exposing an operation to agents (`/api/v1`, MCP) and to pages as one operation contract, and the review card for agent writes. | an API endpoint, MCP tool or page-only write path of your own. |
| [`base/artifacts`](artifacts/README.md) `bilibi_artifacts`<br>Private artifacts (A1, A2) | private documents a record keeps: generated PDFs, sensitive uploaded evidence, their retention and encryption. | ordinary record attachments and uploads (use `base/media`). |
| [`base/audit`](audit/README.md) `bilibi_audit`<br>Audit evidence contract | the evidence of who changed what; every `MutationBoundary` write is captured automatically, plus recorded action facts. | an audit table, change log or history rows of your own; never insert audit rows by hand. |
| [`base/audit_views`](audit_views/README.md) `bilibi_audit_views`<br>Audit screens | showing a record's change history (the `record.history` embed) and the operator audit screens. | recording evidence (use `base/audit`) or a history panel of your own. |
| [`base/authz`](authz/README.md) `bilibi_authz`<br>Authorization owner contract | declaring capabilities, checking them, roles and grants, and masking fields some readers must not see. | role tables, permission flags in code or `is admin` checks of your own. |
| [`base/authz_agent`](authz_agent/README.md) `bilibi_authz_agent`<br>Base Authz Agent | the operation contracts that change grants and roles, shared by pages and agents. | changing grants or roles from your own module. |
| [`base/bulk_data`](bulk_data/README.md) `bilibi_bulk_data`<br>Bulk data: CSV import, export and bulk updates | CSV import, CSV export and setting one field on many records of your type, through your own contracts. | an import page, CSV parser or bulk-update handler of your own. |
| [`base/custom_fields`](custom_fields/README.md) `bilibi_custom_fields`<br>Base Custom Fields | fields a tenant administrator adds to your records without a release. | a field-definitions table, page or operation of your own, or values your logic branches on (keep those in code). |
| [`base/dashboard`](dashboard/README.md) `bilibi_dashboard`<br>bilibi-dashboard | contributing widgets and sections to the `/dashboard` landing page. | a landing or summary page of your own. |
| [`base/database`](database/README.md) `bilibi_database`<br>Database write and seed contracts | every business write (`MutationBoundary`, `Change`), its transaction, migrations and seeds. | an inner transaction, hand-written audit rows or notifications sent outside the write. |
| [`base/datetime`](datetime/README.md) `bilibi_datetime`<br>DateTime display and period contract | showing an instant in the reader's timezone and clock, the timezone settings, and the period filter on lists; time is stored in UTC. | `chrono::Local`, naive local time or formatting a date yourself. |
| [`base/design_library`](design_library/README.md) `bilibi_design_library`<br>Design Library | seeing the shared UI components rendered (Administration › System › Design Library). | building pages (use `base/ui`). |
| [`base/events`](events/README.md) `bilibi_events`<br>bilibi-events | reacting, later and in your own transaction, to something another Domain or Extension did. | asking another module a question now (use `base/ports`), or calling or reading another Domain directly. |
| [`base/grid`](grid/README.md) `bilibi_grid`<br>Grid catalog, page projections, lenses and page columns (G1–G4) | declaring your tables so lists get pickable columns, lenses and saved arrangements; reports and search read the same catalog. | a column picker or per-list join code of your own. |
| [`base/integration`](integration/README.md) `bilibi_integration`<br>Integration exchange log and outgoing transport | every outgoing HTTP call, and the log of incoming and outgoing exchanges. | an HTTP client crate (`reqwest`, `hyper`, `ureq`) of your own. |
| [`base/locale`](locale/README.md) `bilibi_locale`<br>Locale contract | the supported locales, the `ui.locale` setting, and showing money and numbers. | a second locale list or a number formatter of your own. |
| [`base/mail`](mail/README.md) `bilibi_mail`<br>Mail | building and sending email (SMTP or the development mailbox) and reading received email safely. | an SMTP crate or mail sender of your own. |
| [`base/media`](media/README.md) `bilibi_media`<br>Media storage contract | uploading, storing, scanning and streaming files, and private attachments on your records. | `std::fs` writes, a files or attachments table, or a download route of your own. |
| [`base/menu`](menu/README.md) `bilibi_menu`<br>Menu contract | adding your pages to the navigation. | hard-coded links in a template or a host-side link list. |
| [`base/module_registry`](module_registry/README.md) `bilibi_module_registry`<br>Registry contracts | declaring your module and contributing its routes, menu items, settings, capabilities, operations and ports. | a host-owned list of modules, routes or migrations. |
| [`base/notifications`](notifications/README.md) `bilibi_notifications`<br>Notifications and to-dos | telling people something happened (the bell) and putting work on their To do list. | a notifications table, inbox or bell of your own. |
| [`base/party_ids`](party_ids/README.md) `bilibi_party_ids`<br>Party IDs | the typed IDs of people, organisations and affiliations passed between modules. | authority: an ID proves nothing until its owner resolves it in a sealed `Scope`. |
| [`base/perf`](perf/README.md) `bilibi_perf`<br>Perf history | the timing history of requests, live events, jobs and processes, and the Performance page. | timing logs or a metrics table of your own. |
| [`base/personal_data`](personal_data/README.md) `bilibi_personal_data`<br>Personal data contract (`base/personal_data`) | declaring each store of a person's data, so privacy requests, holds and retention reach it. | running those requests (use `base/privacy`) or a personal-data registry of your own. |
| [`base/picklists`](picklists/README.md) `bilibi_picklists`<br>Base Picklists | value lists each tenant curates (categories, sources, reasons), stored on records by a stable code. | values your logic branches on (a Rust enum or a `base/workflow` status), or a lookup table or admin page of your own. |
| [`base/ports`](ports/README.md) `bilibi_ports`<br>bilibi-ports | asking another Domain or Extension a question and getting the answer now, or `Unavailable` when it is not mounted. | a crate dependency between Domains or reading another module's tables. |
| [`base/principal_directory`](principal_directory/README.md) `bilibi_principal_directory`<br>Principal directory contract | naming the people and system principals your rows reference. | joining `users` or other Core tables from Base. |
| [`base/privacy`](privacy/README.md) `bilibi_privacy`<br>Personal data (privacy) | data-subject requests, legal holds, retention sweeps and masked-field reveals. | a deletion or retention job of your own (declare your stores in `base/personal_data`). |
| [`base/queue`](queue/README.md) `bilibi_queue`<br>Durable Queue | background work: a durable job enqueued in your write's transaction, retried, and run as a named system principal. | `tokio::spawn`, a jobs table or a worker loop of your own. |
| [`base/records`](records/README.md) `bilibi_records`<br>Base Records | pointing at a record another module owns, even in another Domain, and showing it as a pill or picker. | a foreign key across modules or a copy of another record's name. |
| [`base/reports`](reports/README.md) `bilibi_reports`<br>Reports (`base/reports`) | saved reports an operator builds over Grid tables, run as each reader, with exports and scheduled delivery. | a report builder or export page of your own. |
| [`base/schedule`](schedule/README.md) `bilibi_schedule`<br>Schedule definitions, review and occurrence claims | recurring work at set times, once per installation or once in every tenant, run through Queue. | `tokio::time::interval`, sleep loops, cron crates or looping over tenants. |
| [`base/search`](search/README.md) `bilibi_search`<br>Search | making your records findable from the top-bar search, `/search` and agents. | a search box or search index of your own. |
| [`base/security`](security/README.md) `bilibi_security`<br>Security facade | existing callers only: an older facade over Tenancy, Session and Authz. | new code (use `base/tenancy`, `base/session` and `base/authz` directly). |
| [`base/session`](session/README.md) `bilibi_session`<br>Base Session | the session store, session checks and signing sessions out. | cookies, tokens or a sessions table of your own. |
| [`base/settings`](settings/README.md) `bilibi_settings`<br>Settings storage contract (P2) | any value an operator could reasonably set, per installation, tenant or company, with secrets encrypted. | constants, environment-only values or a settings table of your own. |
| [`base/settings_editor`](settings_editor/README.md) `bilibi_settings_editor`<br>Settings editor (P3) | showing your settings on the System Settings page (give the setting `editor` metadata). | a settings page of your own. |
| [`base/software`](software/README.md) `bilibi_software`<br>Base Software | what the server runs, finding more modules, and installing tested updates with a backup and undo. | reading a pin file, tag or the catalogue to learn what is installed (use `Composition`). |
| [`base/step_up`](step_up/README.md) `bilibi_step_up`<br>Base Step-up | asking the account holder for a fresh second-factor code before a sensitive operation. | deciding in code whether it applies, or importing the authenticator. |
| [`base/system`](system/README.md) `bilibi_system`<br>System pages | the instance identity (Dev, Staging, Production) and the System Info, Localization and Menu Inspector pages. | reading `BILIBI_ENV` or the origin to decide which instance this is. |
| [`base/tenancy`](tenancy/README.md) `bilibi_tenancy`<br>Tenancy identity boundary | who is acting: the sealed `Scope`, its actor, tenant and current company. | a raw tenant, actor or party ID from a request or argument. |
| [`base/tiling`](tiling/README.md) `bilibi_tiling`<br>bilibi-tiling | the tiled `/workspace` that shows several pages side by side. | a multi-pane page of your own. |
| [`base/ui`](ui/README.md) `bilibi_ui`<br>Shared UI | every page element: components, forms, `FlexTable` lists, dialogs, the shell and live pages. | hand-written markup, copied classes, or CSS and JavaScript in a module. |
| [`base/workflow`](workflow/README.md) `bilibi_workflow`<br>Workflow status kernel | record statuses and their allowed moves, status history, approvals (approvers, rules, cover, reasons, history) and long-running process runs. | an approvals table, status-history table or state machine of your own. |
